name: Roadside inn (relais)
description: Roadside coaching inn (relais), 18 x 9.2 m, after the Little Rock Inn: a long single storey of rubble stone with boarded gables under a slate roof, a full-length veranda on chamfered oak posts with a plank deck and a lean-to tiled roof carrying a long painted sign board, a massive outside rubble chimney on the west gable, small-paned windows and two rear dormers. Kitchen with the big hearth and the inn's salle; an open attic; two stairs.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
